definition_changes.storytelling.fourth_wall_breaking: Explicit acknowledgment of the audience or of the work as a presented fiction, including direct address. Voiceover alone is not sufficient.
definition_changes.narrative_engines.legal_case: Court proceedings, formal adjudication or preparation for a legal case organize the story. Legislative debate or a political committee hearing alone belongs to political_struggle.
definition_changes.relationships.adversaries_cooperate: Characters with genuinely opposing goals cooperate in a consequential shared undertaking; friendly peers in different industries are not automatically adversaries.
definition_changes.relationships.established_couple: An ongoing romantic partnership matters to the story; former partners or separated co-parents alone belong to breakup_or_divorce or parent_child.
definition_changes.themes.disease_and_pandemics: Population-level disease transmission, epidemics, pandemics or public-health response matter as subjects. Personal diagnosis, dying and care are assessed separately as illness_and_dying.
definition_changes.world.simulation: An artificial simulation is an important layer of depicted reality. A physically staged real environment or social deception alone is not a simulation.
definition_changes.world.virtual_reality: Characters experience an interactive digitally mediated environment. A physical set, surveillance broadcast or deception alone is not virtual reality.

policy: Keep prior schemas/raws immutable. New vector order is incompatible with prior arrays. New or redefined values require assessment; no padding or zero imputation.
